questions.q: A bullet train covers a fixed distance in 30 minutes at an average speed of 240 km/h. Due to track maintenance, it needs to be diverted, increasing the distance by 20%. If the train needs to arrive at its destination on time (i.e., in 30 minutes), what should its new average speed be in km/h?
questions.s:
Given:

Time = 30 minutes = 1/2 hour

Initial speed = 240 km/h

Distance increased by 20%

Formula used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculations:

⇒ Original distance = 240 × 1/2

⇒ Original distance = 120 km

⇒ New distance = 120 × 120 / 100

⇒ New distance = 144 km

⇒ Required speed = Distance / Time

⇒ Required speed = 144 ÷ 1/2

⇒ Required speed = 144 × 2

⇒ Required speed = 288 km/h

∴ The new average speed should be 288 km/h.

Yeh 11 se divisible tabhi hoga jab yeh 0 bane, kyunki $x, y$ digits hain aur inka max sum 18 ho sakta hai. So $x+y = 8$. Cross check with 9: Sum of digits = $10+x+y = 18$, jo 9 se divisible hai. Study the statement carefully and decide which conclusion(s) is/are definitely true.
Statement: H ≥ I = J > K ≤ L
Conclusions:
I. H > K
II. I ≥ L
questions.s:
Statement: H ≥ I = J > K ≤ L
Conclusion I: H > K. We have H ≥ I = J > K. Since there is a strictly greater sign (>), H > K is True.
Conclusion II: I ≥ L. We have I = J > K ≤ L. The signs > and ≤ oppose each other, breaking the relation. So, I ≥ L is False.
Only I follows.

questions.q: How many times does the hour hand and minute hand of a clock coincide in half a day?
questions.s:
Given:

We need to find how many times the hour hand and minute hand of a clock coincide in half a day.

Concept Used:

The hour and minute hands coincide 11 times in 12 hours. This is because the hands coincide once every hour and 5/11 of an hour, resulting in 11 coincidences in 12 hours.

Formula Used:

Number of coincidences in 12 hours = 11

Calculation:

Number of coincidences in 24 hours = 2 × 11

⇒ Number of coincidences in 24 hours = 22

Number of coincidences in 12 hours = 11

⇒ The hour and minute hands coincide 11 times in half a day.

∴ In half a day (12 hours), the hour and minute hands of a clock coincide 11 times.

questions_hin.s_hi: The incredibly expansive Western Coastal Plain of India, famously sandwiched tightly between the deep Arabian Sea and the towering Western Ghats, is geographically subdivided distinctly into exactly three sections. The highly rugged northernmost section, beautifully stretching from Gujarat/Daman straight down through Maharashtra and Goa, is officially and historically known exactly as the "Konkan Coast." / भारत का अविश्वसनीय रूप से विशाल पश्चिमी तटीय मैदान, जो गहरे अरब सागर और विशाल पश्चिमी घाटों के बीच प्रसिद्ध रूप से सैंडविच है, भौगोलिक रूप से तीन अलग-अलग वर्गों में उप-विभाजित है। अत्यधिक ऊबड़-खाबड़ सबसे उत्तरी खंड, जो गुजरात/दमन से सीधे महाराष्ट्र और गोवा तक खूबसूरती से फैला हुआ है, आधिकारिक और ऐतिहासिक रूप से "कोंकण तट" (Konkan Coast) के रूप में जाना जाता है।

questions_hin.q_hi: What is the term for a boundary where plates slide past each other, often causing earthquakes, such as the San Andreas Fault? / उस सीमा के लिए क्या शब्द है जहां प्लेटें एक-दूसरे से खिसकती हैं, जिससे अक्सर भूकंप आते हैं, जैसे कि सैन एंड्रियास फॉल्ट?
questions_hin.s_hi: Transform faults are a type of transform plate boundary.

questions_hin.q_hi: How many times does the hour hand and minute hand of a clock coincide in half a day?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given:

We need to find how many times the hour hand and minute hand of a clock coincide in half a day.

Concept Used:

The hour and minute hands coincide 11 times in 12 hours. This is because the hands coincide once every hour and 5/11 of an hour, resulting in 11 coincidences in 12 hours.

Formula Used:

Number of coincidences in 12 hours = 11

Calculation:

Number of coincidences in 24 hours = 2 × 11

⇒ Number of coincidences in 24 hours = 22

Number of coincidences in 12 hours = 11

⇒ The hour and minute hands coincide 11 times in half a day.

∴ In half a day (12 hours), the hour and minute hands of a clock coincide 11 times.

questions_hin.q_hi: Which type of seismic waves can travel through solids, liquids, and gases and are the first to be detected by a seismograph? / किस प्रकार की भूकंपीय तरंगें ठोस, तरल और गैसों के माध्यम से यात्रा कर सकती हैं और सीस्मोग्राफ द्वारा सबसे पहले पता लगाई जाती हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi: P-waves are compressional waves, meaning they compress and expand the material they pass through.
